angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 4,986,082 km at 52.14 pc = 1.28 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 77512: distance 52.138 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.014), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 52.138 +/- 0.73 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 19.4965 +/- 0.0850 mas (same row, RUWE 2.05), 229.5 standard errors, is not used
radiusSource: Radius 7.167 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 77512: radius 7.167 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 36.192 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.049) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 4,986,082 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5292 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 77512: effective temperature 5292 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.043) (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 77512: effective temperature 5292 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.043) (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433)
spectralTypeSource: SIMBAD, * del CrB: spectral type G5III-IVFe-1 (1989ApJS...71..245K)
luminositySource: Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 1222932018450870144, flags_flame 10: lum_flame 36.488945 solar luminosities (16th to 84th percentiles 36.1849 to 36.77904); its log10 is recorded
projectedRotationSpeedSource: SIMBAD, * del CrB: projected rotation speed 7.2 km/s, the measurement SIMBAD prefers (2008AJ....135..209M)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
